'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Pete Flamini DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Pete Flamini]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
